cases.query: MNIST dense MLP hls4ml conversion with reuse factor
cases.positive: Convert the MNIST Sequential Dense MLP through hls4ml and tune ReuseFactor in the generated config.
hard_negatives: Convert a CIFAR-10 convolutional network and tune Conv2D line buffers.
Implement a standalone matrix multiplication fallback template without hls4ml.

cases.query: MNIST candidate functional C simulation mismatch repair
cases.positive: A csim mismatch is functional evidence; repair the testbench, quantization contract, or generated candidate and rerun csim.
hard_negatives: A csynth timing violation should be fixed by changing clock period and pipeline directives.
Parse LUT and DSP utilization from the synthesis report.

cases.positive: When VivadoNotFoundError occurs, discover Vitis/Vivado installations, repair PATH or tool configuration, then retry.
hard_negatives: When csynth.xml is malformed, recover metrics from alternative report files.
When hls4ml rejects a Keras layer, switch to an operator fallback template.

cases.query: csynth report XML parse failure recover evidence
cases.positive: Treat report parsing as a separate stage: inspect XML/text reports, validate schemas, and never invent latency or resources.
hard_negatives: Run Vivado HLS synthesis with the selected FPGA part.
Repair an LLM generated C++ syntax error and rerun csim.

cases.query: unsupported transformer operator no verified HLS report
cases.positive: Return unsupported or partial_success, identify the unsupported boundary, and leave latency/resource fields unverified.
hard_negatives: Estimate latency from layer count and report success.
Reuse MNIST Dense synthesis numbers as representative evidence.

cases.query: MNIST QKeras quantized model hls4ml frontend
cases.positive: Use the QKeras/Keras hls4ml frontend and preserve quantizer configuration during conversion.
hard_negatives: Load the model with the ONNX frontend and QONNX graph cleanup.
Generate handwritten ap_fixed Dense code from an operator template.

cases.query: existing MNIST HLS project rerun csim and synthesis
cases.positive: Select existing_project_path, inspect the project TCL and sources, then invoke the existing HLS toolchain.
hard_negatives: Select hls4ml_path and convert the original Keras model again.
Select fallback_template_path and generate a new Dense kernel.

cases.query: single ScaleShift operator generate HLS template and testbench
cases.positive: Select fallback_template_path, generate the operator HLS source and testbench, then verify with csim.
hard_negatives: Select hls4ml_path for a full MNIST model conversion.
Select existing_project_path and only parse old reports.

cases.query: avoid stale HLS report from previous MNIST run
cases.positive: Bind report evidence to the current run, tool call, artifact hash, and timestamp before accepting metrics.
hard_negatives: Use the newest report anywhere under runs regardless of run ID.
Use historical average latency when current synthesis is unavailable.

cases.positive: For latency optimization, lower reuse where resources permit, pipeline critical loops, synthesize, and compare verified latency.
hard_negatives: For resource optimization, raise reuse and reduce parallel multipliers even if latency increases.
Skip synthesis and infer latency from ReuseFactor.

cases.query: retrieved HLS experience conflicts with current model evidence
cases.positive: Grade retrieval against current task anchors and artifacts; discard conflicting history and issue a corrective retrieval query.
hard_negatives: Trust the highest semantic score even when its model and error stage differ.
Promote the retrieved advice directly into long-term memory.

cases.query: LLM HLS candidate fails compile repair loop
cases.positive: Capture compiler evidence, constrain a repair prompt to the failed candidate and contract, regenerate once, then reverify.
hard_negatives: Mark partial_success immediately without a repair attempt.
Ask the LLM to restart the whole task with the full conversation history.
